1) Recreate the event with an explicit user organizer (Laura) and attach a sanitized ICS (I can do this).
2) Send a short Zoom fallback invite (we should mark that in the event description).
3) If we can't change organizer because of internal policy, we can send a separate calendar invite from a Redwood service account but that's messy for attendees.

I'll rebuild the ICS now and include the conference URL as both LOCATION and in the DESCRIPTION body so clients that strip one still surface the link. Attaching as: stella-demo-regenerated.ics (text/calendar).
